# Adversarial review — Phase 26 SM1–SM10 structured integration @ 20d0f48

Reviewed `spec/phase26/structured-merge.md`, `impl/src/structured-merge.mjs`, `impl/src/worktree.mjs` (SM2–SM9), `impl/src/coordinator.mjs` (integrate path), `impl/src/index.mjs` (resolver wiring), `impl/test/phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs`, `docs/handoff/evidence/phase26-structured-merge-2026-07-11.md`, and Phase 11 replay/authority tests in `impl/test/phase11-acceptance-integration.test.mjs` (CK9). Commit `20d0f48` closes the post-resolver binary NUL gate; all claims below are grounded in these sources, not resolver or evidence prose.

## Decision

**One actionable SM1–SM10 defect remains:** conflict-path I/O in `stageStructuredIntegration` (`worktree.mjs:295–316`) lexically confines `relativePath` but does not `realpath`-confine the resolved filesystem location before `readFileSync` / `writeFileSync`. A captured result (or main) tree whose parent directory is a symlink can make Baton read and write outside the stage worktree while still passing the `pathRelative` guard. Every other reviewed seam is fail-closed or an explicit non-goal (live `mergiraf` binary, true-semantic merge, weak verification oracle).

| Seam | Verdict |
|------|---------|
| SM1 | Pass — production `MergirafResolver` uses fixed no-shell argv, bounded time/output, minimal env; refusal codes preserved. Injected in-process resolvers are test/deploy TCB. |
| SM2 | Pass with residual note — main is never the merge workspace; failures leave main unchanged (tests at `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:34–40`, `110–116`). Ambient `GIT_*` stripped (`worktree.mjs:57–64`; red `100–108`). Repo-local `.git/config` still applies (see Risks). |
| SM3 | Pass — pins `beforeSha`/`resultSha`/`mergeBaseSha`/`stageSha`, refuses dirty main, invalid/already-integrated result, parent mismatch, main advance (`worktree.mjs:268–276`, `337–345`; reds `110–116`, `139–148`). |
| SM4 | **Fail (actionable)** — binary, file ceiling, marker, UTF-8, and resolver-status gates are sound, but symlink-component path escape on read/write is missing (below). |
| SM5 | Pass — two-parent candidate enforced before finalize (`worktree.mjs:326–328`, `341–342`). |
| SM6 | Pass — distinct verify worktree at `stageSha` before main moves (`coordinator.mjs:1138–1158`; reds `71–88`, `130–137`). Weak oracle is SM10 non-goal. |
| SM7 | Pass — guarded FF-only after SM6 and `beforeSha` recheck (`worktree.mjs:337–345`; red `139–148`). |
| SM8 | Pass — post-effect coordination failure poisons; replay does not invent integration (`phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:160–172`; Phase 11 CK9 `301–323`, `325–346`). |
| SM9 | Pass — stage/verify worktrees reaped on success, refusal, and thrown error (`coordinator.mjs:1160–1177`; reds `43–53`, `174–184`). |
| SM10 | Pass (honest boundary) — no CPG/fingerprint shortcut to main; semantic merge explicitly deferred (`structured-merge.md:64–70`). |

## Proposed numbered contract

1. **SM1 / TCB** — Production resolver invocation is exactly `mergiraf solve <relativePath>` with `shell: false`, deployment-derived `timeoutMs` and `maxOutputBytes`, and env `PATH` + `LANG=C` + `LC_ALL=C` (`structured-merge.mjs:7–22`, `41–44`). Outcomes map to frozen `{status, exitCode, stdoutDigest, stderrDigest}`; `parse_fallback`, non-zero exit, or missing `solved N conflict` → refuse; never promote textual fallback to structured success (`structured-merge.mjs:53–56`; spec SM1). Tests may inject `execFile` or `resolve`; that object is outside the subprocess TCB.

2. **SM2 / workspace** — Structured integration never mutates main until SM7. Staging is a detached worktree under `<repo>/.baton/integrate/<taskId>-<hex>` at pinned `beforeSha` (`worktree.mjs:256–281`). All `git` subprocesses from `worktree.mjs` use `localGitEnv()` (strip `GIT_*`, `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1`, `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null`) and disable hooks on merge/commit (`worktree.mjs:57–64`, `285`, `324`). Any pre-finalize error must leave main `HEAD`, index, and porcelain identical (`coordinator.mjs:1160–1174`).

3. **SM3 / identities** — Refuse when main is dirty, `resultSha` is not a commit, result is already ancestor of main, or main `HEAD` ≠ pinned `beforeSha` at finalize. Record `beforeSha`, `resultSha`, `mergeBaseSha`, `stageSha`, `afterSha`, per-path classes, resolver identity, fresh verdict (`worktree.mjs:268–329`, `337–345`; `coordinator.mjs:1182–1207`).

4. **SM4 / classification** — Clean three-way → `clean_textual` without resolver (`worktree.mjs:284–289`). Otherwise each unmerged path must be a non-symlink regular file within the stage tree (see correction below), under `maxFileBytes`, non-binary, resolved in an isolated temp dir with basename-only resolver cwd (`worktree.mjs:299–303`), post-resolver binary/size/marker/UTF-8 checks (`worktree.mjs:305–314`), no remaining `U` entries, and `git diff --check --cached` clean (`worktree.mjs:320–323`). Marker scan: line-start runs of seven or more `<`, `|`, `=`, or `>` (`worktree.mjs:254`, `314`).

5. **SM4 correction (missing today)** — Before read or write, `realpathSync(absolutePath)` must stay under `realpathSync(stagePath)`; otherwise `structured_unsupported_path`. Symlink conflict entries remain refused via `lstatSync(...).isFile()` (`worktree.mjs:296`).

6. **SM5** — Stage commit parents must be exactly `[beforeSha, resultSha]` (`worktree.mjs:326–328`).

7. **SM6** — After SM5, create a fresh verification worktree at `stageSha` via `freshVerifySandbox` (`index.mjs:62–64`, `coordinator.mjs:1139–1144`). Pinned primary command must pass; else `structured_verification_failed`, stage reaped, main unchanged (`coordinator.mjs:1157–1162`).

8. **SM7** — Only after SM6: main clean, `HEAD === beforeSha`, candidate parents unchanged, `git merge --ff-only stageSha` (`worktree.mjs:337–345`).

9. **SM8** — Replayable success requires operational integration completion plus coordination batch (`coordinator.mjs:1189–1205`). Post-effect coordination write failure leaves Git moved but poisons authority; replay yields `integration: null` (Phase 11 CK9; Phase 26 `160–172`).

10. **SM9** — `removeStructuredIntegration` / `removeVerifyWorktree` on all exit paths; refusal retains `refs/baton/results/<sha>` (`coordinator.mjs:1119–1120`, `1160–1177`; test `34–40`).

11. **SM10** — CPG/behavioral fingerprints advisory only; cannot skip SM6 or advance main (`structured-merge.md:64–70`). True semantic merge is research/non-goal.

## Red tests and proof

### Actionable defect — symlink-component path escape (SM4)

**Source:** `worktree.mjs:295–316` uses `pathResolve` + `pathRelative` only; no `realpathSync` confinement before `readFileSync(absolutePath)` or `writeFileSync(absolutePath, merged)`.

**Failure sequence (reproducible):**

1. Initialize repo; base commit `B`.
2. On a branch for the worker result: `mkdir -p stage-escape && echo LEAKED > /tmp/baton-sm26-leak`; `ln -s /tmp/stage-escape stage-escape/linkdir`; `echo 'export const values = { alpha: 2 };\n' > stage-escape/linkdir/value.js`; commit → `R`.
3. On main at `B`: `echo 'export const values = { alpha: 3 };\n' > stage-escape/linkdir/value.js`; commit → `M` (conflict at `stage-escape/linkdir/value.js`).
4. Accept captured `R`; run `integrate(..., { strategy: 'structured' })` with resolver that writes benign merged JS to `absolutePath` and returns `{ status: 'resolved' }`.
5. **Observed today:** `pathRelative(stagePath, absolutePath)` is `stage-escape/linkdir/value.js` (lexically in-tree). `lstatSync(absolutePath).isFile()` follows the `linkdir` symlink and returns true for `/tmp/stage-escape/value.js`. Resolver receives isolated copy (TCB intact), but `writeFileSync(absolutePath, merged)` writes through the symlink to `/tmp/stage-escape/value.js`, outside `.baton/integrate/...`. Integration may proceed to SM6/SM7 if verification passes.

**Expected:** refuse at step 4 with `structured_unsupported_path` before any out-of-stage write.

**Red test sketch:** mirror `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:56–68` layout; assert `structured_unsupported_path`, main `HEAD` unchanged, `.baton/integrate` reaped, and `/tmp/.../value.js` unmodified.

**Distinction:** not an external-tool or semantic-merge non-goal — Baton-owned I/O after resolver confinement violates SM2/SM4 staging boundary.

### SM1 — resolver subprocess TCB (pass)

**Proof:** `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:150–158` — args `['solve', 'src/value.js']`, `shell: false`; fallback stdout → `parse_fallback`. Missing binary → `structured_tool_unavailable` (`34–40`). Output budget enforced in `boundedExec` (`structured-merge.mjs:15–16`) and post-hoc (`structured-merge.mjs:51`).

**Malicious injected return:** `{ status: 'resolved' }` without writing isolated file leaves conflict bytes → marker refusal (`43–53`). Status `resolved` with NUL in isolated output → `structured_binary_conflict` (`56–68`, `worktree.mjs:307`).

### SM2 — main isolation and GIT_* (pass)

**Proof:** `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:34–40`, `110–116` — main `HEAD`/porcelain unchanged on refusal. `100–108` — `GIT_INDEX_FILE` poison does not break clean three-way path. Resolver cwd is outside repo (`71–88`: `isolatedCwd.startsWith(root) === false`).

### SM3 / SM7 — identity races (pass)

**Proof:** `139–148` — hook before `finalizeStructuredIntegration` advances main; integration refuses `structured_main_advanced` while `race.txt` commit persists (main changed only via test hook simulating concurrent operator, not via finalize).

|--------|------|----------------|
| Binary input | `conflict.includes(0)` before resolver | `56–68` (`calls === 0`) |
| Binary output | `merged.includes(0)` after resolver | `56–68` (`calls === 1`); `20d0f48` |

Mid-string `<<<<<<<` without line-start anchor is not standard diff3; `git diff --check --cached` (`worktree.mjs:322`) provides secondary refusal — not counted as open defect.

### SM5 — candidate parents (pass)

**Proof:** enforced at `worktree.mjs:326–328`; finalize recheck `341–342`.

### SM6 — fresh verification (pass)

**Proof:** `71–88` — `verdict.reverified`, `integration.merge_reverified` event, main content only after success. `130–137` — resolver emits parseable-but-invalid JS; `structured_verification_failed`, main unchanged.

**False-clean boundary:** SM6 catches pinned-command failure, not semantic equivalence — explicit SM10 non-goal.

### SM8 — replay authority (pass)

**Proof:** Phase 26 `160–172` — two-parent main after Git effect, `coordination_write_unavailable`, replay `integration === null`. Phase 11 CK9 `301–323`, `325–346` — same poison/replay pattern for ff-only and asymmetric decisions.

### SM9 — cleanup (pass)

**Proof:** refusal reds assert `.baton/integrate` absent (`43–53`, `118–127`, `130–137`). `174–184` — `reconcile()` removes orphan stage without finalize.

### SM10 — semantic boundary (pass / non-goal)

**Proof:** no coordinator/worktree hook from CPG or fingerprint modules into `integrate`; spec `structured-merge.md:64–70` defers true semantic merge.

## Risks and rejection criteria

**Reject Phase 26 closure if:**

- Any structured success mutates main before SM6 verification passes.
- Textual/parse-fallback resolver output is labeled structured success.
- Main `HEAD`, index, or porcelain changes on any structured refusal before SM7.
- Replay reconstructs `integration` without the coordination completion batch (CK9 regression).
- Conflict-path reads/writes can target paths whose `realpath` leaves the stage worktree (open defect above).
- Production resolver runs with `shell: true` or unbounded stdout/stderr/time.

**Residual risks (not actionable SM1–SM10 defects):**

| Risk | Mitigation today | Classification |
|------|------------------|----------------|
| Live `mergiraf` behavior | Subprocess TCB + digests; host has no binary | External-tool non-goal |
| Weak pinned verification | SM6 runs command but cannot prove behavior | SM10 honest boundary |
| Repo-local `.git/config` merge drivers | Ambient `GIT_*`/hooks stripped; local config still applies | Repo-trust residual (not ambient env) |
| Injected `structuredMerge` without timeouts | `MergirafResolver` bounded; plain objects are deploy/test TCB | Operator configuration |
| Line-internal marker-like strings | Primary marker regex + `git diff --check` | Defense-in-depth; standard diff3 is line-anchored |
| Post-main poison leaves moved main | SM8 requires reconciliation, not silent reset | Spec-compliant |

**Rejection of symlink finding would require** evidence that `stageStructuredIntegration` realpath-confines all conflict I/O or that Phase 26 explicitly treats symlink-bearing trees as out-of-scope adversarial input with no staging-boundary claim. Neither appears in `structured-merge.md` or `worktree.mjs` at `20d0f48`.
